diagnostic_engine.legacy_note: component_classes aur labor_to_part_hints sirf reference/provenance ke liye rakhe gaye hain — runtime engine 'normalization', 'hazards' aur 'appliances' use karta hai. Purane global_high_risk_tokens / global_low_risk_tokens hata diye gaye hain kyunki un mein 'nahi', 'off', 'switch' jaise tokens har masle ko LOW bana dete the.

_how_it_works: Do alag pass hote hain. appliance_synonyms pehle chalte hain (item pehchanne ke liye), symptom_synonyms appliance resolve hone ke BAAD chalte hain.
Har 'from' word-boundary regex banta hai (\bfrom\b) — is liye 'ni' se 'pani' kharab nahi hota.
Agar 'from' ke aakhir mein * ho to trailing boundary nahi lagti (prefix match), e.g. 'tapak*' se 'tapakta' bhi match hoga.
Spaces \s+ ban jate hain, is liye extra spaces se farq nahi padta.
Order maayne rakhta hai: spelling fixes pehle, phir phrases.

hazards.label: Dhuwa (smoke)
safety: 🔴 Us cheez ka MCB / main switch FORAN band karein.
🔴 Switch off hone ke baad plug nikaal dein — haath bilkul sookhe hon.
🔴 Kamra ventilate karein (khirki/darwaza kholein) aur appliance ke qareeb na khare hon.
🔴 Dobara ON KABHI mat karein — pehle technician check kare.
🔴 Paas mein fire extinguisher ya sookhi ret rakhein. Pani electrical par mat dalein.

hazards.label: Aag / jalna (fire)
safety: 🔴 Main switch band karein aur ghar walon ko us kamre se bahar nikaalein.
🔴 Electrical aag par PANI mat dalein — CO2/DCP extinguisher ya sookhi ret use karein.
🔴 Aag qabu mein na aaye to Rescue 1122 ko foran call karein.
🔴 Wapas ON karne ki koshish mat karein.

hazards.label: Jalne ki smell
safety: 🔴 Foran band karein — jalne ki smell insulation ya winding jalne ki nishani hai.
🔴 Us point/circuit par koi doosra appliance bhi mat lagayein.
🔴 Technician aane tak istemaal band rakhein.

hazards.label: Chingari / short circuit
safety: 🔴 Us circuit ka MCB band karein — chingari short circuit ki nishani hai.
🔴 Us socket/switch ko dobara use mat karein, bachon ko door rakhein.
🔴 Geeli jagah ya geele haath se bilkul mat chhuein.

hazards.label: Bijli ka jhatka (electric shock)
safety: 🔴 Main MCB band karein — body par current aana earthing fail hone ki nishani hai.
🔴 Jab tak electrician check na kare, us appliance ko haath mat lagayein.
🔴 Kisi ko shock lag jaye to pehle supply off karein, phir usay chhuein.
🔴 Technician se RCCB (30mA) lagwane ka mashwara zaroor lein.

hazards.label: Gas leak
safety: 🔴 Gas valve FORAN band karein aur khirkiyan kholein.
🔴 Koi switch, light ya mobile ON/OFF mat karein — chingari se blast ho sakta hai.
🔴 Maachis/lighter bilkul na jalayein. Ghar se bahar nikal jayein.
🔴 Sui Gas emergency (1199) aur certified technician ko call karein.

hazards.label: Pani + bijli ka mel
safety: 🔴 Us hisse ka MCB foran band karein — pani aur bijli ka mel jaanleva hai.
🔴 Geele farsh par nange paun mat chalein.
🔴 Pani ka source band karein (valve/tank) phir hi safai karein.

hazards.label: Pipe burst / flooding
safety: 🔴 Ghar ka main water valve aur tank ka valve FORAN band karein.
🔴 Pump/motor ka switch band karein.
🔴 Pani ke qareeb wale sockets aur extension boards ka MCB band karein.
🔴 Emergency plumber bulayein — pani ka nuksan har minute barhta hai.

hazards.label: Bohat zyada garam
safety: 🔴 Band karein aur thanda hone dein — zyada garam hona load ya fault ki nishani hai.
🔴 Us par kapra/cover mat dalein, hawa lagne dein.
🔴 Baar baar garam ho raha ho to istemaal band karke technician se check karwayein.

hazards.label: MCB baar baar trip
safety: 🔴 MCB ko baar baar wapas ON MAT karein — yeh fault ka signal hai, isay ignore karna aag ki wajah ban sakta hai.
🔴 Us circuit ke saare appliances unplug karein.
🔴 Licensed electrician se DB check karwayein — khud DB mat kholein.

hazard_default_checks: Appliance ka istemaal FORAN band kar dein — aage koi bhi test khud na karein.
Uska MCB / switch off karein aur plug nikaal dein (haath sookhe hon).
Ghar walon, khaas taur par bachon ko us jagah se door rakhein.
Door se photo/video bana lein taake technician ko dikha sakein — qareeb na jayein.
Technician aane tak dobara ON KABHI na karein.

appliances.label: AC / Air Conditioner
common_safety: AC ka MCB / isolator band karein pehle — AC 220V par chalta hai.
Indoor ya outdoor panel khud mat kholein — andar capacitor charge rehta hai.
Outdoor unit chhat/deewar par ho to bina safety ke us tak mat charhein.

faults.label: Thanda nahi kar raha / cooling weak
checks: Indoor filter nikaal kar pani se dhoein aur sukha kar wapas lagayein — gandi filter cooling 30–40% tak gira deti hai.
Remote COOL mode par ho (FAN/DRY par nahi) aur temperature 18–22°C set karein.
Fan speed HIGH par rakhein aur 'Turbo/Powerful' on karein.
Outdoor unit ke aage-peeche kam az kam 1 foot jagah clear karein — kapra, gamla ya deewar hawa block na kare.
Outdoor unit ka fan ghoom raha hai? Na ghoome to compressor load nahi le raha — foran band karein.
Kamre ke darwaze/khirkiyan band karke 20 minute chalayein, phir grill se nikalne wali hawa check karein.
safety: Gas refill KHUD kabhi mat karein — yeh sirf certified HVAC technician ka kaam hai.
Outdoor unit par cover chadha kar AC mat chalayein.

appliances.label: Fridge / Freezer

Peechay lagi black coil (condenser) garam hoti hai — chhote bachon ko door rakhein.
Fridge ko deewar se 4–6 inch door rakhein warna compressor par load barhta hai.

faults.label: Thanda nahi kar raha

Freezer thanda hai magar neeche wala hissa nahi? To yeh fan/air-flow ka masla hai, gas ka nahi.
Door ki rubber (gasket) check karein — kaghaz darwaze mein daba kar kheenchein, aasani se nikal jaye to gasket dheeli hai.
Peechay lagi coil aur fan par jami mitti saaf karein (plug nikaal kar).
Fridge zaroorat se zyada bhara hua hai? Andar hawa ka guzar hona zaroori hai.
Plug nikaal kar 4 ghante band rakhein (defrost), phir chala kar 6–8 ghante baad dobara check karein.

appliances.label: Ceiling Fan / Pankha
common_safety: Fan ka switch aur uska MCB dono band karein — sirf regulator off karna kaafi nahi.
Chhat wala fan check karne ke liye mazboot seerhi aur kisi doosre banday ki madad lein.
Fan ghoomte waqt blade ke qareeb haath ya jharoo mat le jayein.

faults.label: Slow chal raha hai / speed kam hai
checks: Regulator ko full par karke dekhein — kya speed mein koi farq aata hai?
Blade par jami mitti geele kapre se saaf karein — bhaari mitti se speed ganti hai.
Fan ke center (motor) ko haath laga kar dekhein — zyada garam hai to motor par load hai.
Ghar ke doosre fan bhi slow hain? To yeh voltage ka masla hai, fan ka nahi.
Fan ko haath se ghumayein (switch OFF karke) — free na ghoome to bearing jam ho rahi hai.
Fan start hone mein waqt le raha hai ya hum karta hai? Yeh capacitor weak hone ki classic nishani hai.

faults.label: Bilkul nahi ghoom raha

Ussi board ka doosra switch (light) kaam kar raha hai? Nahi to poora point dead hai.
Switch OFF karke fan ko haath se ghumayein — jam hai ya free ghoomta hai?
Fan se hum ki halki awaz aati hai magar ghoomta nahi? To capacitor gaya hua hai.
MCB check karein — kahin fan wala circuit trip na ho gaya ho.

Holder ke andar kaala/jala nishan ya dheela contact nazar aata hai? (switch OFF karke dekhein)
Tube light hai to uske sire kaale pad gaye hain? Yeh tube khatam hone ki nishani hai.

Ek naya bulb laga kar test karein.
Switch dabate waqt light ka behaviour badalta hai? To switch ka contact ghis gaya hai.
Jhilmilane ke saath 'tik tik' ki awaz ya jalne ki smell ho to us circuit ka MCB band karein.

Socket mein kaali ya jali nishani ho to usmein koi appliance na lagayein.

Plate kaali ya pighli hui hai? Photo bana lein, technician ko dikhayein.
Us point ko istemaal karna bilkul band kar dein.

issues.title: Socket replace

Socket ya plug ka plastic pighla hua hai to usay istemaal na karein.

appliances.label: Wiring / MCB / DB Board
common_safety: DB board ka main switch band karke hi koi kaam karein — aur ho sake to poora meter side isolate karein.
DB board ka cover khud mat kholein — andar live busbar hoti hai.
Kabhi bhi MCB ki jagah taar ya keel (fuse jumper) mat lagayein — yeh aag ki seedhi wajah banti hai.

faults.label: MCB / breaker trip ho raha hai
checks: Note karein: trip kis waqt hota hai — kisi khaas appliance ke on karte waqt?
Ek ek appliance nikaal kar MCB dobara chadhayein taake culprit pakra jaye.
Trip foran hota hai ya kuch minute chal kar? Foran = short circuit, kuch der baad = overload.
Ek hi MCB baar baar trip ho raha hai to usay zabardasti bar bar ON na karein.
MCB ke saath jalne ki smell ya awaz aaye to main switch band karein.

issues.title: Overload — MCB rating theek karna
issues.cause: circuit par load zyada hai, MCB apna kaam kar raha hai

issues.title: MCB khud kharab

issues.title: Short circuit dhoondna aur theek karna

issues.title: Bhaari appliance ke liye alag circuit

faults.label: Short circuit ho gaya hai
checks: Main switch FORAN band karein aur us waqt tak ON na karein jab tak technician na dekhe.
Jahan se awaz/spark aayi thi us jagah ko yaad rakhein — technician ko batayein.
Us hisse mein koi appliance dobara na lagayein.
Jalne ki smell ho to kamra ventilate karein aur pani se aag bujhane ki koshish na karein.

issues.title: Short circuit diagnosis + repair
issues.cause: phase aur neutral kahin milne lage hain

DB board ke qareeb kaghaz, kapra ya plastic ho to door karein.
Poora circuit tab tak band rakhein jab tak technician na aaye.

issues.cause: purani wiring poori load nahi utha rahi

faults.label: Deewar / nal / body se current aa raha hai
checks: Main switch band karein — jis cheez se current aa raha hai usay haath na lagayein.
Bathroom/kitchen mein ho to us hisse ka paani istemaal na karein aur bachon ko door rakhein.
Ghar mein earthing aur RCCB hai ya nahi, technician se pehli baat yeh puchein.
Yeh jaan lewa fault hai — khud tester/screwdriver se check karne ki koshish na karein.

issues.title: Earthing system lagana

faults.label: Ghar / kamre mein bijli nahi aa rahi

DB board par dekhein koi MCB neeche (OFF) position par hai — usay poora neeche kar ke phir ooper karein.
Sirf ek kamra affected hai ya poora ghar?
Meter par light/display aa rahi hai?
MCB ooper karte hi wapas neeche gir jata hai to zabardasti na karein — short circuit hai.

appliances.label: UPS / Inverter / Battery
common_safety: Battery ke terminals par kabhi dono taraf ek saath dhaat (screwdriver/spanner) mat rakhein — spark hota hai.
Battery se nikalne wali gas jalne wali hoti hai — us ke paas maachis/lighter na jalayein.
UPS ka input MCB band karke hi wiring ko haath lagayein — UPS output bhi 220V hota hai.

faults.label: Backup nahi de raha / jaldi khatam ho jata hai
checks: Battery kitni purani hai? 2–3 saal se zyada purani battery ka backup aadha reh jata hai.
Battery ke terminals par safed/neela powder (corrosion) jama hai? Garam pani se saaf karein (UPS off karke).
Terminals dheele hain? Halka tight karein — dheela terminal backup kha jata hai.
Battery ka pani (distilled water) level plates se ooper hai? Kam ho to distilled water daalein, nal ka pani NAHI.
UPS par kitna load laga hai? 2 fan + 3 light se zyada load choti UPS nahi utha sakti.
Bijli aane par UPS charging kar raha hai? Charging light/display check karein.

issues.title: Terminal safai + service
issues.cause: corrosion aur dheele terminal ki wajah se current pass nahi ho raha

issues.title: Battery khatam — replace
issues.cause: battery ki life poori ho gai hai, cells charge nahi rakh rahe

issues.title: UPS ka charging section kharab

UPS ka input MCB ON hai?
UPS ki display/LED par charging ka indication aata hai?
Battery ke terminals tight aur saaf hain?
Battery bohat garam ho rahi ho to UPS foran band kar dein.

Battery ke terminals check karein.
Beep ke saath UPS garam ho ya smell aaye to foran band karein.

Battery phool gai hai ya acid bahar aa raha hai to us ke paas na jayein.

Drum ghoomte waqt usmein haath na daalein, chahe halka lag raha ho.

Machine ka plug aur wire kahin kata ya jala hua nahi?
Darwaza/lid theek band hai? Kai machines lid band na hone par start nahi hoti.
Timer/knob ghumakar dekhein — purani machines mein timer aksar kharab hota hai.
Machine ka apna fuse (peechay) check karwayein.

checks: Machine ka inlet nal (tap) poora khula hai? Aur us mein pressure hai?
Inlet pipe ka filter/jaali nikaal kar saaf karein — usmein mitti jam jati hai.
Drain pipe zameen par mor ke rakhi hai? Usay seedha aur neeche karein.
Drain pipe ka sira nali mein bohat andar ghusa hua ho to bahar kheenchein.
Nali khud jam hai? Bucket se pani daal kar dekhein ke nikaas ho raha hai.

issues.title: Nali / drain blockage clearing

issues.title: Inlet nal / connection repair

checks: Machine ka plug FORAN nikaalein — pani socket ya extension tak pohancha ho to pehle MCB band karein.
Leak inlet pipe se hai, drain pipe se, ya machine ke neeche se? Kapre se poonch kar dekhein.
Inlet pipe ke dono sire haath se tight karein.
Farsh sukha karein — phisalne aur current dono ka khatra hai.

issues.title: Inlet / drain pipe joint repair

issues.title: Machine ke andar se leak (tub/seal)

checks: Machine barabar farsh par khari hai? Tedhi machine bohat vibrate karti hai.

Drum mein sikka, keel ya button gir gaya hai? Plug nikaal kar drum ghumakar dekhein.
Awaz belt/gearbox se aa rahi ho to yeh mechanical fault hai.
Awaz ke saath jalne ki smell aaye to plug foran nikaalein.

issues.cause: machine tedhi hai ya load barabar nahi

issues.title: Belt / gearbox / bearing repair
issues.cause: belt dheeli hai ya bearing ghis chuki hai

faults.label: Dhuwa / jalne ki smell / shock
checks: Us socket ka MCB band karein, PHIR plug nikaalein — machine ko geele haath se na chhuein.
Machine dobara ON na karein.
Machine ke aas paas pani ho to usay sukhayein magar machine ko haath na lagayein.

appliances.label: Geyser / Water Heater
common_safety: Gas geyser hai to kaam se pehle gas ka valve band karein.
Electric geyser hai to uska MCB band karein — pani aur 220V ka combination jaan lewa hai.
Bathroom mein gas geyser ho to darwaza/roshan dan khula rakhein — band bathroom mein gas geyser dam ghutne ki wajah banta hai.
Gas ki smell aane par bijli ka koi switch (on ya off) NA karein — spark se dhamaka ho sakta hai.

faults.label: Pani garam nahi kar raha
checks: Gas geyser hai to gas ka valve poora khula hai? Aur gas pressure theek hai (chulha jala kar dekhein)?
Pilot flame jal rahi hai? Bujhi hui ho to instructions ke mutabiq dobara jalayein — agar gas ki smell ho to bilkul mat jalayein.
Thermostat/knob temperature poora barha kar 30–40 minute intezaar karein.
Electric geyser hai to uska MCB ON hai? Indicator light jal rahi hai?
Nal se garam pani bilkul nahi aa raha ya thora garam aata hai? Thora garam = element/burner weak.
Geyser ke tank par safed calcium ki tehh (scale) ki shikayat purane geyser mein aam hai.

issues.title: Servicing + scale safai
issues.cause: tank aur burner par calcium/scale jam gaya hai is liye heating slow hai

issues.title: Thermostat / element replace

faults.label: Gas ki smell aa rahi hai
checks: Gas ka valve FORAN band karein.
Bijli ka koi switch, light ya exhaust fan ON ya OFF na karein — spark khatarnak hai.
Darwaze aur khirkiyan khol dein aur ghar walon ko us hisse se hata dein.
Maachis, lighter ya cigarette bilkul na jalayein.
Smell tez ho to ghar se bahar nikal jayein aur bahar se Sui Gas emergency (1199) par call karein.

issues.title: Gas pipe / joint leak repair
issues.cause: gas line ka joint ya pipe leak kar raha hai

issues.title: Geyser ka gas valve / burner assembly

faults.label: Geyser se pani leak ho raha hai

Electric geyser ke neeche pani gir raha hai to uska MCB foran band karein.
Inlet/outlet ke nuts haath se halka tight karein (pani band kar ke).
Safety/pressure valve se thora pani tapakna normal hota hai — magar mustaqil behna nahi.
Tank ki body se pani aa raha hai to tank khud gal gaya hai — repair nahi hota.

issues.title: Joint / connection repair

issues.title: Hot water pipe replace

issues.title: Tank gal gaya — geyser replace

Geyser se 'ubalne' ya khatakne ki awaz aana pressure banne ki nishani hai — yeh phatne ka khatra hai.
Geyser dobara ON na karein.

issues.title: Safety / pressure valve replace
issues.cause: safety valve jam ho gaya hai is liye pressure release nahi ho raha

issues.title: Thermostat kharab

Pump ko khali (bina pani) der tak na chalayein — seal jal jati hai.

faults.label: Pump chal nahi raha
checks: Pump ka MCB / switch ON hai? Us point mein current hai (doosra appliance laga kar check karein)?
Pump se 'hum' ki awaz aati hai magar ghoomta nahi? To capacitor ya jam impeller ka masla hai.
MCB band karke pump ka fan/shaft haath se ghumayein — jam hai ya free?
Pump ki body bohat garam hai? Thanda hone dein — thermal cut-off ho sakta hai.
Pump ka MCB baar baar trip kar raha hai to zabardasti ON na karein.

issues.title: Capacitor / starting fault
issues.cause: capacitor kharab hone se motor start nahi ho raha

issues.title: Impeller jam / replace

issues.title: Poora pump replace (1.0 HP)
issues.cause: motor winding jal chuki hai, naya pump behtar rahega

faults.label: Chalta hai magar pani nahi kheench raha
checks: Underground tank ya boring mein pani mojood hai? Pehle yeh confirm karein.
Pump ke ooper wale plug se pump mein pani bharein (priming) aur phir chalayein.
Suction line ke joints se hawa aa rahi hai? Hawa aane se pump pani nahi kheenchta.
Suction pipe ka jaali/strainer mitti se band ho sakta hai — nikaal kar saaf karein.
Delivery valve poora khula hai?

checks: Confirm main MCB/isolator is ON at the distribution board.
Test the switch/socket with another small appliance (e.g. phone charger).
Check for loose faceplate screws or burnt marks on the switch.
If multiple points fail on one circuit, suspect MCB or wiring — not just the switch.
safety: Turn OFF the relevant MCB before opening any switch plate.
Never touch bare wires.
Dry hands only.

checks: Note which MCB trips and when (all loads vs single appliance).
Unplug recently added devices on that circuit.
Do NOT repeatedly reset a tripping breaker — it indicates a fault.
safety: Repeated tripping can cause fire — stop using the circuit.
Only a licensed electrician should open the DB.

checks: Verify wall switch and regulator are ON and set to maximum.
Listen for humming without blade movement — typical weak capacitor sign (see dataset: Ceiling Fan Capacitor).
Check blade screws are tight if wobbling is reported.
If motor smells burnt or grinds loudly, stop use — motor/rewinding may be needed.
safety: Switch OFF MCB before opening fan canopy.
Capacitor stores charge — never touch terminals.
Use stable ladder.

checks: Replace bulb/tube with a known working one first.
Check switch and holder contacts for corrosion.
For tube lights, check starter/chock if fitted.
safety: Switch OFF before replacing bulbs or opening holders.

checks: Check battery age — typical UPS battery life 1-2 years in Pakistan heat.
Verify input power reaches the UPS when grid is available.
Burning smell from UPS = disconnect immediately.
safety: Battery acid and charging circuits are hazardous.
Ventilate battery area.

checks: Shut nearest isolation valve immediately for any active leak.
Visible joints: check tightening and Teflon tape on threads.
Concealed/hidden leaks need wall access — see dataset labor: hidden/concealed pipe repair.
safety: Water near electrical points is dangerous — isolate power nearby.
Main valve off for major leaks.

checks: Close isolation valve under basin/sink.
Do not over-tighten handle — washer damage worsens drip.
Check aerator/shower head for blockage if flow is weak.
safety: Place bucket to limit water damage.
Turn off overhead tank valve if leak is heavy.

checks: Check visible trap/grating for hair/debris blockage.
Flush tank: verify fill valve and flapper if water runs continuously.
Outdoor gully cover — remove surface blockage first.
safety: Wear gloves for sewage blockages.
Avoid chemical drain cleaners on old PVC.

checks: Confirm tank has water — dry-run protection stops many pumps.
Check float switch position in overhead tank.
Humming without flow may indicate capacitor or impeller jam (see dataset parts).
Verify suction foot valve if pump loses prime.
safety: Never run pump dry more than a few seconds.
Power OFF before impeller inspection.

checks: Gas geyser: check pilot/flame and ventilation.
No hot water: verify gas supply and water inlet valve.
Any gas smell — ventilate, do not operate switches.
safety: Gas leaks are life-threatening — call certified technician.
Do not bypass safety thermostat.

checks: Check filter cartridge replacement schedule.
Verify inlet water pressure meets RO requirement.
Storage tank valve open.
safety: Sanitize lines after cartridge change per manufacturer guide.

checks: Clean indoor filters first — cheapest fix (see AC general service in dataset).
Set remote to COOL mode 18-22°C.
Outdoor unit airflow clear.
Persistent weak cooling after filter clean → gas refill may be required (dataset: AC gas refill services).
safety: Gas refill requires certified HVAC technician — not DIY.
Do not run AC with covers on outdoor unit.

checks: Turn OFF AC and MCB if breaker trips on AC start.
Note burning smell at outdoor unit.
Do not keep resetting breaker.
safety: Compressor replacement is major work — professional only.
High voltage at outdoor unit.

checks: Power cycle indoor unit once (MCB off 2 min).
Check remote batteries.
Persistent fault codes → PCB diagnosis (see dataset PCB repair labor).
safety: Do not open indoor PCB cover unless qualified.
Capacitors hold charge.

checks: Indoor water dripping: check drain pipe blockage (dataset: Drainage pipe unclog).
Outdoor fan noise: debris in fan blade path.
Annual service improves cooling efficiency.
safety: Isolate power before cleaning indoor unit.
Secure outdoor unit bracket before monsoon.
